name: faq-journey
title: FAQ Journey
description: FAQ as a numbered path: a vertical line with one step per question and one answer open at a time.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; question: ReactNode; answer: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Questions in reading order. Each gets a numbered step on the line.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Id of the step that is open first.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the open and close take.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
